scope: Independent read-only review of the first bounded callback-free native Node-link editor-type switch refusal. The sole new production consumer is Apple ED_area_newspace when the existing editor is SPACE_NODE and the requested type differs. Exact public Area.type false behavior is reviewed; no generic editor-lifecycle closure is claimed.

source_result.consumer: area.cc2861-2870 guard is first, before Python-sensitive CTX_wm_window(C), BKE_spacetype_from_id, previous-space/header inspection, temporary type.exit writes, Paint teardown and native area/region exit callbacks. Same-type Node requests and changes from other editor types bypass the new query.
source_result.native_profile: ED_node.hh46 declares an Apple-only helper defined beside the real static native callbacks at node_relationships.cc1615. It compares invoke/modal/poll/cancel identities, exec=null, pyop_poll=null, exact REGISTER|UNDO|BLOCKING flags and empty type macro endpoints. It invokes no callback and reads no running operator, drag, tree or socket. Native NODE_OT_link registration/invoke/modal/cancel bodies are unchanged against the pinned primary source.
source_result.raw_context: CTX_wm_manager is the raw C->wm.manager accessor (context.cc764). CTX_wm_window/area/region/screen may read Python context overrides; CTX_data_main may call generic context providers. The query uses only the raw manager accessor and avoids those provider-sensitive getters and every context setter.
source_result.query_roots: Null C, target, G_MAIN or missing/foreign raw context manager refuses. Raw manager must be a member of G_MAIN->wm before use. Once these roots are established, the query scans every manager/window modal list in current G_MAIN. C.window, active screen, target active-screen membership and target region are not used. The target is only compared as an opaque area address.
source_result.absence_default: No area-relevant OP handler permits native fallback even for inactive/no-active-screen areas or a manager with no windows. Non-OP handlers and handlers for other areas are ignored before operator/type access. This preserves valid no-owner editor switches and prevents a foreign C.window from hiding an original registered handler.
source_result.types: A listed operator type pointer is compared against WM_operatortypes_registered_get before its fields are read. Missing/unregistered types refuse. Current registered NODE_OT_link identity refuses even if its profile was replaced. A distinct registered type satisfying the exact native profile also refuses. Other well-formed registered nonmacro operators retain native fallback under this bounded identity/profile policy.
source_result.macros: Actual registration stores the mother macro as handler.op and the active child in root.opm (WM_event_add_modal_handler_ex). Macro traversal validates previous links and final endpoint, compares root.opm to actual root.macro members before dereferencing that active-child value, then checks active!=root, active.opm==root, empty active macro endpoints, registered child type and nonmacro child type. Actual Node child/profile refuses; a valid unrelated active child permits native fallback. Missing/inconsistent root/child relations refuse. No child or root callback is invoked.
source_result.pending_removal: WM_HANDLER_DO_FREE is not skipped. A matching actual native Node handler remains present until actual intrusive-list cleanup, then a fresh query can permit retry.
source_result.no_grant: No customdata, SpaceNode/runtime, NodeTree, owner ID, session UID, node/socket, physical input/contact, lifetime token, receipt, allocation, poll, invoke, modal, Cancel, provider or report dispatch is added by the query. Its Boolean result is bounded exit refusal/absence policy, never a positive ownership, cancellation or dispatch grant.
source_result.registry_initialization_assumption: WM_operatortype_find uses a local fixed char buffer, StringRef and quiet registry lookup; WM_operatortypes_registered_get returns a view. Their backing get_operators_map has a lazy first-ever reserve(2048). Query registry access is delayed until an actual relevant listed modal operator, whose ordinary creation follows registry initialization. Allocation-free therefore applies to the ordinary valid editor/UI corridor, not an arbitrary fabricated pre-initialization handler or first-ever registry call.
source_result.rna_observed_snapshot: The exact existing rna_Area_type_set stores transient butspacetype. rna_Area_type_update saves window/area/region, switches to owning screen context, calls checked ED_area_newspace and on false clears butspacetype, restores window then area then region and immediately returns. Real spacetype/type, type.exit, spacedata/region lists and original registered modal area/region remain untouched by the new refusal. The false path precedes redraw, DEG/snode updates and gizmo notifier. Existing butspacetype_subtype is not reset on false.
source_result.context_limit: The observed/restored snapshot is saved window/area/region only. CTX_wm_window_set also changes scene/workspace/screen, and setters may clear Python override members. If the saved window is null, its previous data.scene is not restored by window_set(null). This review does not assert byte-identical bContext/Python-dict restoration or zero Python-context work across the entire outer RNA setter corridor. The new query and refused ED_area_newspace entry run no such getter/setter; zero Paint/native exit/cancel/poll work is the relevant claim.
source_result.native_fallback: Existing no-owner exit/space creation/reuse/header/subtype/title/redraw/notifier behavior remains below the guard. Actual native Finish/Esc/RMB completion followed by real handler removal allows a fresh retry. This source review does not execute those terminal callbacks or claim generic graph rollback.

literal_preservation.result: Independent raw SHA256 comparisons match all seven prior Python targets and all fourteen prior GHOST targets, with no mismatches. The only changed prior targets are area.cc, WM_api.hh and wm_event_system.cc; ED_node.hh and node_relationships.cc are newly patched pinned-source targets.
acceptance_contract: No new report, banner, label, button, Finish/Cancel control, layout or UI text is introduced. Area.type refusal remains the existing silent false path.
During a refused switch, finish by ordinary native lift or use existing native Esc/RMB Cancel, then retry. Native Cancel is not promised to restore an input link detached during invoke.
Preserve exact nine Base actions: Layout / Mode, More Tools, Undo, Redo, Select, Move, Rotate, Scale, Cursor; preserve current ring order, geometry, empty center and contextual controls.

Preserve compact corner Ring/context/Undo/Redo/Expand, native-only More Tools inventory and all129 native icons, full default Blender bars/menus/headers/toolbars/status and advanced native editor controls.
Preserve accepted Inspector, native editors/splits, workspace rails/global lock, Canvas expansion/restoration, Close View and fullscreen Back controls.

Preserve all GHOST producer/event/queue/coalescing/physical classification behavior, Pencil squeeze/doubletap/barrel Home, stationary hover/pressure/tilt and external keyboard/mouse/native navigation and history semantics.

deferred_and_limits: Generic ED_area_exit/ED_region_exit, region removal, join/swap/screen exit/offscreen replacement and other direct region/context replacement receive no new consumer guard. Multi-target atomicity requires early preflight before all writes/callbacks and is not inferred.

Same-editor subtype changes, tree/owner deletion or replacement, ordinary Pencil interruption/terminal synthesis, positive owner/contact leases, native cancellation/retirement and arbitrary custom callback lifetimes remain separate.
rna_Area_ui_type_update unconditionally tags refresh after delegating to type update. Strict no-write/no-refresh outer no-op proof is limited to public Area.type, not broad ui_type.

ED_area_prevspace restores saved subtype on false and stacked-temp flags are written after success, but full fullscreen/temp-window outer atomicity is not claimed. ED_screen_full_newspace writes WAS_ACTIVE before calling newspace and clears it on false without saving a preexisting bit; WM_window_open_temp does broader setup before its checked call and cleanup. These preexisting outer behaviors are explicitly deferred.

The query assumes ordinary synchronous UI-thread current live intrusive lists and ordinary listed modal-operator validity. It does not prove arbitrary corrupted pointers, cycles, concurrent list mutation, global heap/reentrancy/CFG/GPU/UIKit/history correctness or all callback clones with altered profile fields.
